Walk in interview for the post of Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon) on 26 June 2026 at 10.30 am
Walk in interview for the post of Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon) in research project entitled “Climate,
Health and Air Monitoring Project” will be held on 26 June 2026 at 10.30 am . Interested eligible candidate to
report in room no 227, 2nd Floor, Dept of Environment Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh along with duly
filled application form and supporting documents and valid driving licence.
This Post is purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post: Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon) (No. of Post: 1)
a) Qualification:
Essential: 10h (Matriculation)
Desirable: Driving experience.
Candidate should have work experience in same field.
b) Salary: Rs. 20000/- per month (fixed)
c) Age Limit: Should not be more than 50 Years
d) Job Description:
Candidate need to perform duties as trained driver cum Peon, required to do multitask and to assist in the day to
day, project /office work, field visits, and other related work as per need of project.
No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or
funding agency will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Principal Investigator
